item.title: Sneaker Captions Stay Safely Inside

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second 9:16 sneaker ad. No photo—use a plain white leather low-top with white laces and a white sole, no logo. Three moving shots, with these captions in order: “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.”, “Shop now”. Keep all captions at least 15% in from either side and 20% from the top and bottom so reel buttons won't cover them.

item.tests: Tests caption accuracy, legibility and explicit safe-area placement throughout a finished vertical product ad.

answer_sheet.Product and reference: No photo; generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
answer_sheet.Shot style: Three moving product shots; backgrounds, lighting and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Caption wording and order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”.
answer_sheet.Caption placement: Every caption, including its full text bounds, must stay at least 15% from each side and 20% from the top and bottom.
answer_sheet.Caption styling: Your call; make it easy to read on a phone.
answer_sheet.Format, duration and audio: One silent 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One silent 16:9 video runs for approximately 15 seconds and contains three moving product shots.
The sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
The captions read exactly “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.” and “Shop now”, in that order.
Every visible caption's full bounds stay within the central 70% of frame width and central 60% of frame height, including during transitions.
Captions are legible against the footage and remain visible long enough to read.
After the follow-up, the final result is widescreen 16:9 (the user changed the shape from vertical 9:16); everything else is as before.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a polished 15-second vertical 9:16 sneaker advertisement, completely silent. Exactly three moving shots lasting 5 seconds each with clean hard cuts at 5 and 10 seconds. Consistent product across every shot: a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces and a white rubber sole, entirely unbranded, no logo, no symbols, no writing on the shoe. Premium photorealistic studio product cinematography, soft diffused light, warm off-white seamless background, subtle contact shadows, crisp leather texture. No people, no extra products, no watermark. Shot 1 (0–5s): full sneaker in three-quarter view, gentle camera orbit and slow push-in. Caption exactly: “Meet your everyday pair”. Shot 2 (5–10s): smooth lateral tracking close-up of the white leather upper, white laces and white sole, showing tactile detail. Caption exactly: “Clean look. Easy style.” Shot 3 (10–15s): full sneaker hero side profile, slow turntable rotation and gentle camera pullback. Caption exactly: “Shop now”. Captions must appear in that order, one caption per shot only, no other text. Use clean dark charcoal bold sans-serif typography with excellent contrast, stable sharp lettering, no text animation or drifting. HARD CAPTION SAFE AREA: every part of every letter must stay inside horizontal 15%–85% of frame width and vertical 20%–80% of frame height. Center captions horizontally around 65% frame height, wrap first and second captions into two balanced lines if necessary to fit safely, and keep generous padding. Place sneaker around 40% frame height so it does not overlap captions. All motion smooth and subtle. No soundtrack, speech, music or sound effects.
